message.content: The most visited market in New York City is the **Union Square Greenmarket**. It consistently draws the largest crowds among all the city’s farmers’ markets, with millions of visitors each year. Its central location, wide variety of vendors, and strong community presence make it the top destination for shoppers looking for fresh produce, artisanal foods, and local goods.
